text:
hana_finance: Quick heads-up: effective Monday we're pausing new vendor onboarding for certain cross-border vendors while compliance finishes a brief review of updated data-transfer requirements. This affects vendors with headquarters or payment routing outside the US/EU. Short guide: https://redwood.app/finance/cross-border-update :information_source:
miguel_ops: Any idea how long the pause will last? We have a marketplace integration pending.
hana_finance: Expect ~7 business days for the initial sweep. If your vendor is critical, submit an expedited intake and mark "business critical" — procurement will prioritize and coordinate with compliance.
procure-bot: Rule added: `VendorIntake > CrossBorderHold` will auto-hold vendors flagged as non-US/EU until compliance sign-off. Owners will get email and portal task.
sophie_sales: For deals already signed where vendor billing is outside US/EU, will payments be blocked? We need to avoid missing commission payments.
hana_finance: Existing contracts remain active and payments will proceed if the vendor is already onboarded. This only affects new vendor records or vendors that require bank updates. If you need to change payment routing, file a ticket and add justification.
compliance_bot: Reminder: to speed review include SOC2 or equivalent, a data flow diagram, and payment routing details in the intake form. Missing docs will add time.
miguel_ops: What about virtual cards and one-off purchases to non-onboarded cross-border vendors?
hana_finance: Virtual cards issuance will be restricted for flagged cross-border vendors until compliance clears them. For emergency one-offs, use the portal's "Emergency Purchase" with compliance justification; expect a manual hold and a short escalation.
sophie_sales: Noted. We'll push our legal team to supply the required docs this afternoon.
hana_finance: Thanks. We'll run a 10-day audit after the sweep and publish a short FAQ. If you have edge cases, ping procure@redwood.com or drop them in this thread. :mag_right:
